sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 2x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies buff removal resistance, preventing karma or any buff removal effect one time. [Demerit]
-Target: all enemies. Increases physical and magic Ability Power of damage taken by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases physical and magic attack Ability Power by 40 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases all stats by 180% for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Increases buff limit for all stats by 100% for 120 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Siege for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases ATK and MATK by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies status ailments; nullifies special status ailments; nullifies special debuffs; Applies Vital Strike (10% chance to increase damage dealt by 50%). Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 30000
Confuse and Prohibit Unison Resistance Up by 60

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies blessing (recovers 50 Cost, increases max HP by 100%, nullifies status ailments and Unison Gauge reduction effects, reduces cooldown times by 50%, and recovers 20% of max HP every 5 seconds) for 120 seconds.
